title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Share of the Reinstatement Fee by How Far the Account Is Square
content:
## Accounts receivable schedule

The reinstatement fee taken on a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record follows how far the account has been brought square. The reading is the instalments invoiced on the agreement against the payments received on it, measured against the value of one instalment of the annual price in force — that is, the annual price in force divided by the tier's instalment count.

| Reading of the account | Reinstatement fee taken |
|---|---|
| the payments received on the agreement now reach the instalments invoiced on it | the fee the tier publishes at the cleared account share, that is 50 percent of it |
| the payments received fall short of the instalments invoiced by no more than the value of one instalment of the annual price in force | the fee the tier publishes at the part cleared share, that is 75 percent of it |
| the payments received fall short of the instalments invoiced by more than the value of one instalment of the annual price in force | the fee the tier publishes |

### Boundaries (hypothetical figures)

An agreement whose annual price in force is 4 800.00 USD billed in 4 instalments has an instalment value of 1 200.00 USD, at a tier publishing a reinstatement fee of 400.00 USD.

- Payments received reaching or exceeding the instalments invoiced: 50 percent of 400.00 USD, that is 200.00 USD.
- Payments received falling short by exactly 1 200.00 USD: "no more than the value of one instalment", so 75 percent of 400.00 USD, that is 300.00 USD.
- Payments received falling short by 1 200.01 USD: more than one instalment's value, so the published fee of 400.00 USD.
